notes: Posted 26 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (9): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Prepared Defenses, First Strike, Imperial Arrest Order, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the 60.
Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Sullust and Endor dested the Dark printings of those locations.

The ten cards under 'Defensive shields' dested the Reflections III Defensive Shield printings (Secret Plans, You Cannot Hide Forever, Allegations Of Corruption, Battle Order, Do They Have A Code Clearance?, Fanfare and Wipe Them Out, All Of Them are the shield versions, not the Effects of the same names); the 'Defensive shields' header is not a card.
Imperial Arrest Order is posted alone in the starting section (Secret Plans is listed separately among the shields), so it dested the standalone Endor Effect.
Posted 'Elis herlot' dested Elis Helrot; 'Chimaira' Chimaera; 'Neimodian advisor' Neimoidian Advisor; 'Hoth wampa cave' Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker); 'Prepared defences' Prepared Defenses.
